summary: Plan is sound but lacks a documented rollback path and explicit success metrics.
strengths: Clear scope with an explicit out-of-scope section
Risks identified up-front, including the codex workspace constraint

non_blocking_findings.title: No rollback plan documented
non_blocking_findings.why_it_matters: Without a stated rollback, a regression in the runner contract could prolong any incident.

non_blocking_findings.title: Success criteria are implicit
non_blocking_findings.why_it_matters: Reviewers cannot tell when the harness is 'done' without measurable acceptance criteria.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Approach lists steps but no pass/fail thresholds.

open_questions: Should the harness fail closed on schema violations, or only warn?
